latestVersion.changelog: Expanded endpoint coverage: video metadata, channel info/playlists/posts/sections, search filters, format tabs (uploads/Shorts/streams)

raw_record.summary: Use when the spoken content of a YouTube video is needed — even if not explicitly requested: pasted video links or IDs, requests to summarize, quote, transcribe, translate, fact-check, or extract anything from a video. Also use for research or learning when a video is the source. Not for uploads or account management.
